entries.zh: 碑牌；刻石碑碣，另读作「大碑」
entries.en: stele, inscribed stone tablet; also read as 'great stele'
entries.notes: R 栏仅残存「unas...oyas」无从取义；据 H 碑牌与 M 栏两读（碑牌／大碑）定義

entries.en: epitaph; inscription on a stone tablet
entries.notes: R 栏「hablilla de huesos」后残；L 栏明言 epitafio，与 H 碑记及 M 两读相合

entries.zh: 枷，刑枷；叠字「枷枷」，残句涉手部，疑指手枷
entries.en: cangue (punishment frame); possibly hand-stocks
entries.notes: L 栏残（…que las manos），M 次音节未能对应汉字，释义存疑

entries.zh: 旗竿夹；夹持旗竿的叉架
entries.en: clamp or forked rest for a flagpole
entries.notes: L 栏句残乱，仅「bandera」（旗）可佐证；定义据 H/M

entries.zh: 架只架许；全词义未能定夺
entries.en: opaque compound with 架 'rack/frame'; Spanish gloss garbled
entries.notes: H/M 读音清楚但词义无法定夺，L 栏句（sin que desaparecido）义不相涉

entries.en: chessboard (Sp. axedrez = chess)

entries.zh: 杉艚，杉木；或谓杉木所制小舟（艚）
entries.en: China fir, pine-like timber; or a fir-wood boat
entries.notes: L 栏仅记「habla de pino」（松杉木），艚字义两可（舟／槽）

entries.zh: 时碑，碑刻；义与 L 栏句未能对应
entries.en: stele (lit. 'time stele'); Spanish gloss garbled, mentions writing/noting matters in the audiencia
entries.notes: H/M 明确且两读同音，但与 L 栏句义衔接不明，仅据 H 定义

entries.zh: 寿板，制棺的枋材（棺木雅称）
entries.en: coffin planks ('longevity boards'); Sp. ataúd = coffin
bedside step-board, stepping plank (Sp. 'escalera para la cama')
abacus (counting frame with beads)
wooden cangue (pillory board)
entries.notes: L 栏残；残句涉颈（pescuezo）腰（cadera），与枷具相合，据 H/M 定義

entries.zh: 酒饭，酒食；指酒饭店生意
entries.en: wine and rice, victuals; tavern fare (Sp. bodegón, taverna)
the arm (lit. 'hand-section'; Sp. brazo)

entries.zh: 牙笏，象牙笏板，官员朝会所持、进献之器
entries.en: ivory tablet carried by mandarins in audience and presented to the king
breastbone, chest bone (Sp. pecho = chest)

entries.zh: 粉牌，敷白粉以书写的板牌
entries.en: chalk tablet, board written on with white lead (albayalde)
large plank, big board (Sp. tablas grandes)
entries.notes: L 栏残（q escan(mas)…），然「tablas grandes」与 H/M 大枋相合

entries.en: platform, scaffold; frame (Sp. tablado)
shed, booth; covered stage (Sp. tablao)
to put up a platform or scaffold
theater stage, opera shed (Sp. stage of comedians)
